answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed island vouching only for itself, no vertex of it reaching real peers. Honest identities gather many independent vouches like a comet trailing many sparks; a ring has only its own, so the counting rule starves it however large it grows.
